bonus.root_cause: The primary SQL replica exceeded its connection limit due to misconfigured max_connections.
The connection pooler exhausted its available connections due to misconfigured parameters.

resolution_steps: Run crictl delete --force all stopped containers

bonus.root_cause: The node's kubelet service had crashed due to excessive pod allocation.
The internal DNS cache became corrupted due to a missing registry_gc run.

resolution_steps: Set MTU to 1500 on interface eth0
Update routing table with command nft add rule inet filter input tcp dport 22

bonus.root_cause: The WAN aggregation router was configured with an incorrect MTU size.

resolution_steps: Restart edge load balancer on node 1
Update DNS TTL to 300 seconds using nslookup

bonus.root_cause: The edge load balancer failed to properly distribute traffic due to a misconfigured timeout.
The WAL archive process hung due to insufficient wal sender resources.

resolution_steps: Set OSPF cost to 10 on interface eth0

bonus.root_cause: The OSPF backbone area failed to converge due to mismatched timers.

resolution_steps: Set max recursion depth to 10 in /etc/named.conf
Restart named service on all recursive DNS nodes
Update nftables rule 5 to allow UDP packets on port 53
Verify DNS query timeout is set to 2 seconds

bonus.root_cause: The recursive DNS resolver cluster was overwhelmed by excessive queries due to a misconfigured max recursion depth.
